title: A Two-Person Startup Has Fixed One of the Most Hated Sounds in Modern Life
summary: The challenge Corelitz and Coogan set themselves was this: better microwave sound, sound with some personality; but no new hardware, so using existing chips and existing buzzers. Starling’s test rig is an Arduino linked to three piezo buzzers for sound comparison.
